findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: check_business_schema, check_business_info · Private data: check_llms_txt, check_business_info, generate_ai_robots_txt, quick_ai_visibility_check · Public sink: check_business_info · Destructive: check_ai_crawler_access, check_llms_txt, check_business_info, quick_ai_visibility_check.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: check_business_schema, check_business_info · Private data: check_llms_txt, check_business_info, generate_ai_robots_txt, quick_ai_visibility_check · Public sink: check_business_info · Destructive: check_ai_crawler_access, check_llms_txt, check_business_info, quick_ai_visibility_check

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
